items.name: simm-sensitivity-table
items.title: SIMM sensitivity table
items.description: Display of a SIMM sensitivity set by risk class: every delta, vega and curvature entry as supplied.
items.docs: Display-only view of a SimmSensitivitiesJson document (for example the canonical text useSimmSensitivitiesValidator returns, parsed). Sections follow the SIMM risk classes (interest rate, credit qualifying, credit non-qualifying, equity, commodity, FX); each holds the class's delta and vega tuples in input order, with columns named after the Rust tuple positions, and the curvature entries whose risk_class is that class. Empty fields are omitted. Nothing is summed, netted, regrouped or converted; amounts are in the set's base currency, which is shown. Accepts sensitivities, formatValue and density props; no worker or query provider required.

items.name: simm-report
items.title: SIMM report
items.description: Display of a native SIMM initial-margin result: headline amount, an indicative badge, the component breakdown and a simm_detail drill-down.
items.docs: Display-only view of the ImResult returned by useSimmIm (margin.SimmCalculator#calculateFromSensitivities). The headline is the returned amount with methodology, as_of, mpor_days and the detail's mpor_scale. An Indicative badge is always shown, beside the returned approximation flag: the result is for indicative funding and capacity analysis, not for reconciling a counterparty margin call. The breakdown lists the returned component amounts as exact money in returned key order; the drill-down shows the returned risk_class_margins and, for a selected component, its buckets (k, signed_sum) and weighted sensitivities (risk weight, concentration factor). Nothing is aggregated. Accepts result, loading, error, formatValue and density props; no worker or query provider required.

items.name: simm-calculator
items.title: SIMM calculator
items.description: Edits a SIMM sensitivity set and calculation date, shows the validated set by risk class and presents the returned initial margin.
items.docs: Composes schema-form over the generated simm_sensitivities_json contract (started from defaultJson, else the Rust schema example), a date-input for the calculation date, simm-sensitivity-table over the natively validated canonical set and simm-report over the returned ImResult. Validation and calculation are caller callbacks: connect validate to useSimmSensitivitiesValidator and onSubmit plus result, loading and error to useSimmIm. Rust accepts only USD-based sets; another base currency surfaces the native error in the report. Accepts defaultJson, asOf, onAsOfChange, validate, onSubmit, result, loading, error, formatValue and density props.

items.name: use-simm-im
items.title: useSimmIm
items.description: Calculates indicative SIMM initial margin of a sensitivity set through the WASM worker.
items.docs: margin.SimmSensitivities.fromJson over sensitivitiesJson, new margin.SimmCalculator(version, mporDays) with omitted options left unset so Rust applies its defaults (version v2_6, registry MPOR), then calculateFromSensitivities in the set's own base currency on asOf. Both handles are freed. Rust accepts only USD; another base currency, an unknown tenor or an invalid date returns the native error unchanged. Keyed on the complete request and worker session. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: use-simm-sensitivities-validator
items.title: useSimmSensitivitiesValidator
items.description: Validates SIMM sensitivity JSON natively and returns its canonical text through the WASM worker.
items.docs: margin.SimmSensitivities.fromJson, validate and toJson: canonical SimmSensitivitiesJson text, or the native error for unknown fields, currencies, tenors or credit sectors. The handle is freed. Pass it as schema-form's or simm-calculator's validate. Requires the shared Finstack provider.
